candidates.change_summary: Remove the `|| super.supportsInterface(interfaceId)` disjunct so only the IAccessControl interface id is supported.
Change `||` to `&&` so the function only returns true if both checks pass, making IAccessControl and IERC165 interface ids return false.
Remove the IAccessControl check so only ERC165's interface id (and any super overrides) is supported.
Return true unconditionally instead of reading the role membership mapping.
Return false unconditionally instead of reading the role membership mapping.
Return the negation of the stored membership flag.
Return the role identifier itself instead of the stored admin role, so getRoleAdmin always returns the queried role.
Return the DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE constant instead of the stored admin role, so getRoleAdmin always returns 0x00.
